summary: Cloudflare adapter composition root for executable plugins. First-party modules are registered in code and invoked in-process; third-party plugins use the signed remote binding. Both go through the shared PluginExecutionPort; this directory owns no journal, retry loop, staging or publication.

key_files.index.ts: Lazy composition root: resolve an in-code plugin binding and construct the in-process execution port with hosted ExecutorContext services.
key_files.in-process.ts: One module invocation with a timeout and per-isolate submit replay keyed by durable invocationId. Returns the protocol result; never publishes.
key_files.registry.ts: Closed allowlist of Worker-safe first-party executor modules plus their manifest version/schema hash and declared idempotent exports. Dynamic import keeps plugin JSON out of startup.
key_files.context.ts: Invocation-scoped store/upload/asset/document/reference ports. Credentials come from the selected provider account and never enter the journal.
key_files.action-context.ts: Invocation-scoped bytes-only context for executable Actions: pinned Asset references resolve to verified bytes, and plugin outputs go through the same R2 broker the Durable Run stages from.
key_files.action-invoker.ts: Action-port binding: resolve code first, fall back to the user's sealed remote endpoint, then invoke the shared port with durableRunIdempotencyKey(run). First-party ids never fall through to remote. Remote references are Project Assets resolved through services/project-asset-references.ts (an unavailable one fails reference_unavailable before the plugin is called); a media run also gets one run-scoped output upload capability per accepted slot (services/plugin-output-sessions.ts). Both are built per invocation and never journaled.

compatibility: Only first-party in-process and third-party remote bindings are implemented; the container binding stays typed for the render adapter.
A provider route or Action is admitted only when its plugin id is explicitly allowlisted or the user has a validated remote endpoint; modules import no node:fs or child_process at module scope.
